Class MoleculeView

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.api.MoleculeView
public final class MoleculeView extends Object
A read-only view of molecule definitions and item/fluid matching rules.

The view keeps the definitions it was created with. If you retain it across a reload, it still describes the old state; request a new view to see the new definitions.
